mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as lower rates reduce the cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 255 indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 255.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and a large labor force (PAYEMS > 150000 thousand) indicates labor market overheating that triggers inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signal sustained consumer demand momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A current INDPRO reading above 105 indicates robust industrial activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through immediate economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) indicates sustained consumer demand strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through extended economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A current UNRATE reading above 4.5% indicates economic weakness that triggers corporate earnings headwinds, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced consumer spending and investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of industrial production (INDPRO) supports corporate earnings growth through stronger manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as economic momentum persists.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO predicting 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
